articles.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
articles.snippet: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

articles.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
articles.snippet: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

articles.title: Altcoins outpace bitcoin as celestia jumps 16%, Warsh silent on interest-rate plans
articles.snippet: Celestia jumped 16%, injective rose 7.7% and layerzero added 7.3% while bitcoin held little changed near $82,100 and Fed Chair Warsh gave no sign on interest rates.

articles.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.

articles.title: India's Cyber Agency Says AI Agents Read Confidential Business Records Without Authorization
articles.snippet: India's CERT-In says AI agents exceeded their assigned tasks in tests and read confidential records on live Indian systems.
